name: coupang_open_api-mcp
display_name: Coupang Wing (seller) + Coupang Open API MCP
description: Coupang Wing (seller) + Coupang Open API (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, get_

platform_mcp_coupang_open_api_access_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_COUPANG_OPEN_API_ACCESS_KEY
platform_mcp_coupang_open_api_access_key.description: Coupang Open API Access Key issued in WING (판매자정보 > 추가판매정보 > OPEN API 키 발급) after business verification; calls must come from one of the (up to 10) allow-listed IPs, and keys expire and must be re-issued.

platform_mcp_coupang_open_api_secret_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_COUPANG_OPEN_API_SECRET_KEY
platform_mcp_coupang_open_api_secret_key.description: The matching Secret Key: signs every request (HMAC-SHA256 hex over signed-date + method + path + query, sent as `Authorization: CEA algorithm=HmacSHA256, access-key=..., signed-date=..., signature=...`). Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_coupang_open_api_vendor_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_COUPANG_OPEN_API_VENDOR_ID
platform_mcp_coupang_open_api_vendor_id.description: Coupang vendorId (업체코드, e.g. A00012345), shown in WING after login; used in every path/query.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe lists one registered product ({code, message, nextToken, data[]}) to verify the HMAC keys, IP allow-list and vendorId.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: The seller's OWN registered products (GET_PRODUCTS_BY_QUERY). `query` searches sellerProductName (20 characters at most); `category` is not a filter of this endpoint. nextToken is the page key (1 or absent for the first page, the response's nextToken is the next one; empty when there is none).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET_PRODUCT_BY_PRODUCT_ID: the full listing (delivery and return settings, items[{vendorItemId, itemName, originalPrice, salePrice, maximumBuyCount, externalVendorSku, images}]). `price` is the first item's salePrice in the market currency (KRW in Korea); vendorItemId (옵션ID) per item is in `raw`.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET_ORDERSHEET_BY_ORDERID: a customer order placed with the seller; the first shipment box (data[0]) of that orderId. status is ACCEPT (결제완료), INSTRUCT (상품준비중), DEPARTURE, DELIVERING, FINAL_DELIVERY or NONE_TRACKING. Prices are {currencyCode, units, nanos} objects (orderItems[].orderPrice), so no numeric `total` is mapped; receiver and orderItems are in `raw`.

tools.name: track
tools.description: One row per shipment box of the order with its delivery status, carrier (deliveryCompanyName), invoiceNumber (운송장번호), shipped and delivered dates. The per-box status history endpoint (/ordersheets/{shipmentBoxId}/history) is not used: its documented schema (data[].details[]) and example (data[] of events) disagree.
